attributes.title: 2027 NDHA Annual Session
attributes.summary:
The Nebraska Dental Hygienists' Association holds its 2027 Annual Session on Friday, March 19, 2027, in Bellevue, Nebraska. The one-day program is for practicing hygienists, educators and students and includes vendor breaks, student presentations and the NDHA induction ceremony.

The posted agenda lists CE for each block: myofunctional therapy updates (1.5), the mouth-body connection and case acceptance (1.5), unusual clinical cases (1.0), the membership meeting (1.0), caries arrest and repair (1.5), the vendor and student session (0.5) and advanced operator positioning (1.0), which adds up to 8.0 CE for the full day. A Courtyard room block is offered at $114; registration fees are on the registration form.
